reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a dedicated tempo run to build threshold strength, a crucial component for sustained speed on trails, while Plan B solely focuses on easy runs. Furthermore, Plan A includes cross-training sessions, which are beneficial for overall fitness and injury prevention, something absent in Plan B. While both plans have similar rest days, Plan A’s structured approach to developing different aspects of fitness makes it more effective for the stated goal.
